messages.content: In one sentence, what is the Kiln inference server?
Kiln is a single-binary, single-GPU inference and online-training stack engineered specifically for Qwen3.5-4B.
Kiln is purpose-built for the Qwen3.5-4B architecture; the scheduler, memory manager, and CUDA kernels are tuned for that one model.
What language is Kiln written in?
Kiln is implemented entirely in Rust, with Marlin W4A16 GEMM and a hand-tuned hybrid GDN plus GQA forward pass.
